title: Quieter hook messages build plan
approval: Build plan approved: quieter hook messages

short.lead: The build is three steps, one issue each, starting with the log; I need your approval to begin step 1.
short.hint: Tap a step to see it.
items: Build the log and the hook-log command
Status messages are written to a log file instead of the chat. `/house-rules:hook-log` prints the latest ones, and `HOUSE_RULES_TRACE=chat` brings the old behaviour back.
Each autosave run gets its own scratch file. A real error prints as one line, once per session.
Updates the trace-tier docs, adds the changelog line, and sets a new plugin version number.
Tap Copy my reply and send it.

changes: Done when: after a Bash call with the design loop off nothing prints in chat, and `/house-rules:hook-log` shows the message.
Done when: two autosaves started together give no error, and a forced error prints one line once.
Done when: `verify.py`, `verify_tools.py`, `docref.py check` and `docs_drift.py` all exit 0 and the version-bump check passes.

wrapup.summary: This plan makes the plugin's status messages go to a log instead of the chat, fixes the autosave collision, and is tracked as three issues under #583 (Quieter hook messages: status messages go to a log, not the chat).
wrapup.changing: The trace functions in core.py, the autosave code in delegation.py, a new hook-log command, the trace-tier docs, and the plugin version number.
